mentions.name: Anti-spam email/messaging protocol
mentions.description: This protocol is an anti-spam mechanism for email and messengers that is simple and cheap to implement, directly compatible with existing email/messengers, achieves a low false negative rate compared to current spam filtering, is free for senders, and does not require senders to pay to send messages. It is designed to also work against AI-generated spam in the future, unlike current spam filtering methods.
mentions.problem: People receive too much marketing spam, survey spam, and low-effort cold emails and waste time on them; current spam filtering methods have higher false negative rates and will not work on future AI spam.
mentions.audience: people who receive too much marketing spam, survey spam, and low-effort cold emails and want to filter them out without wasting time
mentions.source_excerpt: Anti-spam email/messaging protocol that is simple, cheap to implement, directly compatible with email/messengers, low false negative rate compared to current spam filtering, free for senders, and does not require the sender to pay to send a message.
